notes.title: Free Director's Cut Update Launching Tonight
notes.notes:
The Director's Cut is a major update for Collection Quest
Releasing Tonight Completely Free

Includes:

 Expanded Areas
 New Quest to complete 
 and Secrets to discover
 Overall improved game fidelity
 with an overall improved gameplay experience
 Introducing Local and Remote-Play CO-OP
 Preserves the ability to play the original or switch to the director's cut seamlessly
 As well as save compatibility, no lost progress here!


This is the definitive way to experience Collection Quest!
